description: Intraday earnings tracker update for a company that just reported — beat/miss summary with supporting news sources. One slice of the earnings family, not a stand-in for it.
A company's earnings results release detected on announcement day — LLM summary of the reported numbers with news sources.
An earnings-family update tied to a new 10-Q release. Provides a fully updated snapshot of the company along with an updated PDF report.
A new earnings-call transcript has been analyzed and saved to transcript_timeseries_analysis — payload carries thesis deltas (added/removed/strengthened/weakened) and the guidance outlook.
Analysis of an earnings-related 8-K filing — as-reported EDGAR financials with key takeaways, flags, a recommendation, and links to the SEC filing.

Analysis of a new investor-relations publication (earnings deck / presentation) scraped from the company's own IR site — summary, verbatim reported metrics, guidance commentary, flags, and a link to the source document.
Cross-company thematic synthesis of the current earnings season — emerging, fading, and reinforced themes across recent reporters.
Market-wide news-flow synthesis — emerging, fading, and reinforced themes plus macro risks and sector implications. A single latest snapshot rather than per-symbol events.
Material breaking-news update on a company from the news-significance workflow — thesis-relevant developments outside the scheduled earnings cycle.
Top intraday percentage gainers among covered symbols.
Largest absolute intraday movers (either direction) among covered symbols.
Largest intraday decliners among covered symbols.
Significant institutional position changes detected in newly filed 13Fs for covered symbols.
Positions a specific 13F filer opened for the FIRST time in its latest filing — keyed by filer CIK rather than stock symbol.
Positions a specific 13F filer closed out COMPLETELY in its latest filing — keyed by filer CIK rather than stock symbol. `data` carries the prior-quarter size of the stake that was sold.
New sell-side analyst rating actions — upgrades, downgrades, initiations, and price-target changes.
Changes in consensus analyst estimates for upcoming reporting periods.
Strategy portfolio updates (SMID / momentum / multi-signal) including intraday ADD/REMOVE changes in the intraday_changes array.
Updates to LLM-curated thematic stock baskets — holdings changes and the basket rationale.
Refreshed model-predicted stock return scores and recommendations.
